tasks.label: Verify local launch prerequisites
args: node --version; npm --version; py -3.12 --version; Get-Command node,npm,py,psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source; Get-Service -Name '*postgres*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Status; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5432,8000,5173 } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; 'backend_env=' + (Test-Path backend\.env); 'backend_venv=' + (Test-Path backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe); 'frontend_env=' + (Test-Path frontend\.env); 'frontend_node_modules=' + (Test-Path frontend\node_modules); Get-ChildItem frontend -Name *lock* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
